sources.title: An Embarrassingly Simple Detector for Model Extraction Attacks
sources.snippet: We formulate model extraction monitoring as benign-calibrated traffic-window distribution testing and show that an embarrassingly simple detector is effective: embed incoming queries into a semantic space and test whether their aggregate distribution deviates from historical benign traffic.
